summary_en: FY2026/09 dividend revised: regular 3 yen/share + special 1 yen/share = 4 yen/share total (vs. prior guidance of 3 yen regular). Special dividend marks 40th anniversary. Q2/FY2026 0 yen (unchanged). Effective date 30 September 2026.
title_en: Notice on 40th Anniversary Special Dividend (Revision of Dividend Forecast)
translation_en_brief: Shinozakiya announced on 14 August 2026 a revision to its FY2026/09 dividend forecast. The board resolved to pay a special dividend of 1 yen per share (record date 30 September 2026) to commemorate the company's 40th anniversary, in addition to the previously guided regular dividend of 3 yen per share. The total FY2026/09 dividend is now 4 yen per share (vs. prior guidance of 3 yen regular only). No Q2/FY2026 dividend (record date 30 June 2026) was paid. The company cited strong momentum in existing retail operations and the contribution of pop-up stores as new-business drivers. The special dividend expresses gratitude to long-term shareholders and reaffirms management's commitment to future growth.
